people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.
translations.bsb: But the Scripture pronounces all things confined by sin, so that by faith in Jesus Christ the promise might be given to those who believe.
translations.kjv: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
translations.asv: But the scriptures shut up all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
